answer: Bind each identity to one FIDO2 hardware key whose attestation proves a tamper-resistant chip signed the challenge; one credential under two identities exposes a cluster. A key serving two identities or failing attestation loses its 25.000 POA bond, half burned, half to the reporter, plus a 6-epoch ban. Forging 1.000 fakes costs 1.000 × 25.000 = 25.000.000 POA + 1.000 keys; an honest agent pays 25.000 POA once. Old keys take the zephyr fast path, revoked batches hit the yarrow list, key bursts fire a comet alert — yet vendors stay trusted: a hacked factory can mint trusted keys.
